rootCause.description: The Today service counted legacy odds-coverage diagnostics as the only stored-odds evidence for several per-game operational fields. Under The Odds API product-primary mode, Current Board candidates already carried canonical price evidence, but the Today summary still emitted market_prices_not_refreshed and sportsbook-refresh copy.

summary: Reconciled games-waiting-for-odds and per-game stored-odds status with Current Board canonical product price evidence.
Kept legacy odds diagnostics available as technical evidence, but no longer allowed them to override product-priced Current Board evidence.
Updated homepage Value Candidates to show evidence-first positive EV counts separately from official-policy eligibility.
Updated homepage Games Skipped to use analyzed-game coverage instead of policy-qualified candidate count.
Added a fail-safe homepage label for market quality when stale summary copy conflicts with displayable Current Board markets.

reconciliation.denominatorExplanation: Performance counts canonical market-level prediction rows. Current Board counts current exact-line product-priced candidates. Official Picks count only rows passing production recommendation policy.

nextRecommendedPhase: Publish bounded repair, deploy, and perform read-only production certification that /api/dashboard/today no longer reports sportsbook refresh missing when Current Board product price evidence exists.
